title: Entry Requirements by Plan — PracticePay Patient Financing
content:
Each PracticePay Patient Financing plan has its own entry requirements: a minimum FICO Score 8 for the applicant, the smallest and largest treatment amount it finances, the provider specialties that may offer it, how long an approval stays usable, and how many open plans a patient may hold at the same provider.

## Credit score, amounts and approval period

| Plan | Minimum FICO Score 8 | Smallest amount financed (USD) | Largest amount financed (USD) | Approval usable for (calendar days after the approval date) | Open plans at the same provider at once |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PracticePay 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 640 | 200.00 | 10000.00 | 60 | 1 |
| PracticePay 6-Month No Interest Plan | 660 | 200.00 | 7500.00 | 60 | 1 |
| PracticePay 12-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 660 | 500.00 | 15000.00 | 60 | 1 |
| PracticePay 12-Month No Interest Plan | 680 | 500.00 | 10000.00 | 60 | 1 |
| PracticePay 24-Month Reduced APR Plan | 640 | 1000.00 | 25000.00 | 90 | 2 |
| PracticePay 48-Month Reduced APR Plan | 660 | 2500.00 | 35000.00 | 90 | 2 |
| PracticePay 60-Month Extended Plan | 600 | 3000.00 | 40000.00 | 90 | 2 |

## Provider specialties that may offer each plan

| Plan | Eligible provider specialties |
|---|---|
| PracticePay 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan | dental, orthodontic, vision, hearing, dermatology, cosmetic, veterinary |
| PracticePay 6-Month No Interest Plan | dental, orthodontic, vision, hearing, veterinary |
| PracticePay 12-Month Deferred Interest Plan | dental, orthodontic, vision, hearing, dermatology, cosmetic, veterinary |
| PracticePay 12-Month No Interest Plan | dental, orthodontic, veterinary, hearing |
| PracticePay 24-Month Reduced APR Plan | dental, orthodontic, vision, hearing, dermatology, cosmetic, fertility, veterinary |
| PracticePay 48-Month Reduced APR Plan | dental, orthodontic, fertility, cosmetic, hearing |
| PracticePay 60-Month Extended Plan | dental, orthodontic, fertility, cosmetic |

## Terms common to every plan

- **Treatment charges per plan:** 1. Further treatment needs a new plan.
- **Responsible party:** a parent or guardian may apply as the borrower for a minor patient's or a pet's treatment (allowed on every plan).
- **Checking the approved amount:** uses a soft credit inquiry before the patient accepts the plan (on every plan).

## Points of reading

- A fertility practice may offer only the 24-Month Reduced APR, 48-Month Reduced APR and 60-Month Extended plans; a veterinary practice may not offer the 48-Month Reduced APR or 60-Month Extended plans.
- The approval period is 60 calendar days on the four promotional plans and 90 calendar days on the three others.
